title: Lior and the Spire
author: Tamsin Montrose
blurb: Theo Dravenmoor, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
